steps.name: Incoherent Voice
steps.text: Fire! FIRE!

steps.name: Incoherent Voice
steps.text: Assassins! Protect His Majesty!

steps.name: Incoherent Voice
steps.text: Guards, guards—

steps.name: Patrolling Guardsman
steps.text: Put out that fire! Lock the dining area down!

steps.name: Lin Qingyan
steps.text: Take care—

steps.name: Lin Qingyan
steps.text: The source of this fire...

steps.name: Lin Qingyan
steps.text: Everyone! Stay away from the wine in the cups!

steps.name: Lin Qingyan
steps.text: (A fire that does not burn hot...)

steps.name: Lin Qingyan
steps.text: (Who did this... and what are they up to?)
Lin Qingyan tries to calm down the panicking crowd, but her voice is quickly drowned out by the shouting and screaming.
In the midst of the chaos, she spots a familiar face.
Their eyes met for only a moment, but she is more sure than anything.
That person saw her, saw her attempt to cross the line of propriety in front of all.
But the target is not her.

steps.name: Lin Qingyan
steps.text: Blaze...!

steps.name: Mo Bufu
steps.text: What's going on? What's with all this ruckus?

steps.name: Veteran Chef
steps.text: This is bad! I heard some kind of demonic fire broke out at the banquet! No idea how it happened!

steps.name: Veteran Chef
steps.text: The guards have the dining area surrounded. No idea what's going on inside, or if His Majesty is hurt...

steps.name: Veteran Chef
steps.text: They're talking about... cutting the Feast short...

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Lin Qingyan...!

steps.name: Guard A
steps.text: We've been notified of unknown persons infiltrating the Feast. We will now be conducting an inspection.

steps.name: Guard A
steps.text: I ask that everyone stay where they are and not move. Please cooperate.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: (Dammit... What the hell happened over where Leizi is?)

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: (This is bad. I can't leave her to fend for herself. I need to go take a look...)

steps.name: Guard B
steps.text: You there! Stop moving!

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: (What do I do what do I do? I can't get in a fight here!)

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: (No time to think, dammit!)

steps.name: Guard B
steps.text: After her!

steps.name: Guard Chief
steps.text: First Battalion, Fifth Battalion, seal off the southern entrance! Seventh and Ninth, close the northern gate!

steps.name: Guard Chief
steps.text: Everyone else, sweep the palace from south to north. If you find anyone suspicious, arrest them immediately.

steps.name: Guard Chief
steps.text: Our intel says there are at least two culprits working together to ruin the Feast, so take care!

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: So many guards... What a pain.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: What kinda trouble did you manage to get yourself into here, Leizi?

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Sounds like you haven't gotten caught yet, at least... So where the hell are you?

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Tsch... This palace is way too big...

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Why're you here?!

steps.name: Ning Yin
steps.text: Shh—

steps.name: Ning Yin
steps.text: I thought you two just wanted to ask His Majesty to reopen the case? How did it come to this?

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: I don't know either! That fire's not our doing!

steps.name: Ning Yin
steps.text: But the timing...

steps.name: Ning Yin
steps.text: You need to leave, right away! There's no talking your way out of it if they find you.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: What I need to do is save Lin Qingyan!

spans.text: to do is save Lin Qingyan!

steps.name: Ning Yin
steps.text: ...Let me go look for her.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: How can I ask you to do something that dangerous?!

steps.name: Ning Yin
steps.text: I'm more familiar with the Forbidden City than you are. Even If I did get caught, I'll have some leeway to explain myself.

steps.name: Ning Yin
steps.text: Don't worry. I'll find her.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: But...

steps.name: Ning Yin
steps.text: You still don't trust me. What, still angry at me?

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Of course not—

steps.name: Ning Yin
steps.text: Head to the southern exit, before the guards seal it off!

steps.name: Ning Yin
steps.text: We'll meet up at that restaurant once we're all out of here.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: ...Okay.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: You take care too.

steps.name: Ning Yin
steps.text: Wait, did the soldiers manage to get a good look at you?

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Err... Yeah, I think so.

steps.name: Ning Yin
steps.text: That's... not good.

steps.name: Ning Yin
steps.text: Oh, I know! Let's swap clothes. Come on, get them off.

steps.name: Patrolling Soldier
steps.text: I saw someone running away up ahead! Over there!

steps.name: Ning Yin
steps.text: *Sigh*...

steps.name: Ning Yin
steps.text: The dining area's been cleared out... Deputy Minister Lin wouldn't be here.

steps.name: Ning Yin
steps.text: But who started all this at the Feast...

steps.name: Ning Yin
steps.text: I hope Blaze managed to make it out by now—
Why is she here?
These two...
Is this fate at work?

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Looks like it's not too far away now...

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Wonder how things are going over on their side...
Found you...

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Who's there?!

steps.name: Junior Drillmaster
steps.text: So it was you.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Damn... That's one hell of a sword!

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: You're not dressed like your average soldier. What are you, a general?

steps.name: Junior Drillmaster
steps.text: Save the chatter.

steps.name: Junior Drillmaster
steps.text: So you're the one Lin Qingyan has been hiding behind her back... But why would she bring you to the Forbidden City?

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Err... So I know it's impolite to barge in on someone else's banquet, but would you believe me if I said we didn't mean anything bad by it...?

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: What I'm trying to say is that this is all a misunderstanding...

steps.name: Junior Drillmaster
steps.text: There is no misunderstanding here. The Imperial Guard have been searching for you for forty years.

steps.name: Junior Drillmaster
steps.text: You are her descendant.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: What are you talking about? Whose descendant? Who's 'her'?

steps.name: Junior Drillmaster
steps.text: You really don't know—

steps.name: Junior Drillmaster
steps.text: No. It seems you're not lying.

steps.name: Junior Drillmaster
steps.text: All this time you've been hidden away, and nobody thought to tell you about your history?

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Haha, got me there... I'm pretty curious about it, not gonna lie. Anyone I can ask about it?

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: But seriously, the Imperial Guard? Looking for me?

steps.name: Junior Drillmaster
steps.text: Forty years ago, only a single child was unaccounted for in the family of a treasonous mandarin.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: You... What are you talking about?

steps.name: Lin Qingyan
steps.text: Blaze... I need to confirm something...

steps.name: Lin Qingyan
steps.text: You were born in 1062, in Victoria, right?

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Yes. From as far back as I can remember, I lived in Victoria.

steps.name: Lin Qingyan
steps.text: Your father seemed to have been spending a lot of time pursuing a certain 'truth' in the last few years of his life.

steps.name: Lin Qingyan
steps.text: What if... you found out everything around you was one big lie...

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Wha...?

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Y—You're talking nonsense! Bi zui!

steps.name: Junior Drillmaster
steps.text: You are a person of interest. We'll figure out what to do with you after questioning.

steps.name: Junior Drillmaster
steps.text: Come with me.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Forget that!

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: (Gah—!)

steps.name: Junior Drillmaster
steps.text: You're no weakling, it seems. I might not be able to take you in without hurting you.

steps.name: Junior Drillmaster
steps.text: If you don't wish to be harmed, then surrender immediately.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: I'm not in the mood for jokes right now!

steps.name: Lin Qingyan
steps.text: (Panting heavily)

steps.name: Lin Qingyan
steps.text: Didn't I tell you... to save yourself if... something happened...?

steps.name: Junior Drillmaster
steps.text: ...Lin Qingyan.
Lin Qingyan's eyes meet Blaze's.
She understands what has happened, but all she has to offer is silence.
She turns and stands in front of Blaze, shielding her.

steps.name: Junior Drillmaster
steps.text: Your deeds at the Judicial Review Office are worthy of my respect, Deputy Minister Lin. And I was kind enough to remind you before.

steps.name: Junior Drillmaster
steps.text: It seems you have decided to completely ignore my warning.

steps.name: Lin Qingyan
steps.text: I am perfectly aware what I'm doing. I don't need your reminders.

steps.name: Junior Drillmaster
steps.text: You know who she really is. Yet to go so far as to protect the descendant of a traitorous mandarin...

steps.name: Junior Drillmaster
steps.text: Why?

steps.name: Lin Qingyan
steps.text: For the truth. The truth you are all too afraid to talk about.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Lin Qingyan!

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: What are you two talking about...? What do you mean... I'm the descendant of a traitor?

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: My dad... Who is he? Why did he die...?

steps.name: Lin Qingyan
steps.text: Forgive me. I was planning to tell you everything after tonight. But it seems now is not a good time.

steps.name: Lin Qingyan
steps.text: I will make it up to you later however you like. Provided we make it out of here alive, that is.

steps.name: Junior Drillmaster
steps.text: She will be coming with me tonight.

steps.name: Lin Qingyan
steps.text: As long as I am here, she will not.

steps.name: Junior Drillmaster
steps.text: Forget that. You will need three of you to simply obstruct me.

spans.text: of you to simply obstruct me.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Lin Qingyan!

steps.name: Lin Qingyan
steps.text: Go already!
A burst of lightning blasts open a hole in the palace wall. Before the dust has even settled, a somewhat gentler blast of energy strikes Blaze.
She is sent flying out of the Forbidden City, falling towards a distant patch of ground.
Blaze has done these sort of high-altitude leaps countless times before as a form of dynamic entry into the battlefield, or wherever happened to need her.
She has never once felt fear. She believed in her own strength, and in her many friends.
There was never any confusion in her mind either. She knew who she was. She knew where she must go. She knew what she believed in.
There is no plot that can hold back her heat, just like how the mist of dawn cannot hide away the sun.
But now?
What awaits her is no longer solid ground, but an endless abyss.
She closes her eyes.

steps.name: Ning Shu
steps.text: Where...?
Ning Yin lies on the bed, her breathing faint.
The crutch in the old man's hand shudders, and he nearly falls over.
After having seen so many things across so many years, he thought nothing more in this world could shock him.
His lips open and close, yet try as he might, he can make no sound.
Until someone in the shadows begins to speak first.
She yet lives.

steps.name: Ning Shu
steps.text: It's you—
Stay your steps, Mr. Ning. Come no closer.
You never saw me tonight, and she never left the house.

steps.name: Ning Shu
steps.text: She... But why...?
She intruded upon the Feast of a Hundred Delicacies. She was with that girl when I discovered her.
If she had run into anyone else, she would not still be alive.

steps.name: Ning Shu
steps.text: Impossible...

steps.name: Ning Shu
steps.text: Forty years... I can't believe it's you again...

steps.name: Ning Shu
steps.text: Forty years ago, you left her here. Now, you save her life once more, save her from a terrible fate.

steps.name: Ning Shu
steps.text: Fate... This must be fate...

steps.name: Ning Shu
steps.text: There's no escaping it. There never was.
I did not leave her here for her sake. It was you who saved her, Mr. Ning.
You once swore an oath to never let anyone know the truth of this case in exchange for her name. But it seems you are now wavering when it comes to past vows.
The True Lung will know of tonight's events.
The choice is yours, Mr. Ning.
A gust of wind, and it was like nobody was even there.
The old man stands in stunned silence.
His daze is interrupted as he hears a sound coming from outside the courtyard walls.
A sound like roaring, like weeping, like admonishment.

steps.name: Ning Shu
steps.text: I must be going mad...

steps.name: Ning Shu
steps.text: It's autumn. Why do I hear cicadas...?

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Ah—!

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Where... How did I get here?!

steps.name: Young Chef
steps.text: Oh, finally awake I see.

steps.name: Young Chef
steps.text: I knew you were one tough Feline. Look at you, as lively as a fin on a line.

steps.name: Young Chef
steps.text: Jiang was making a fuss about calling a doctor. He was shouting so hard he forgot what time it was.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: How long was I out... Wait, where are they?!

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Lin Qingyan... Did Ning Yin come by here? I... Seriously, how did I get here?

steps.name: Young Chef
steps.text: Alright, slow down. I don't even know where to start with all these questions.

steps.name: Young Chef
steps.text: Last night I was on my way to the night market to get some cheap veggies when I found you lying down in the middle of the street. Thought you were drunk at first.

steps.name: Young Chef
steps.text: I was worried you'd freeze to death or something, so I brought you back here.

steps.name: Young Chef
steps.text: You were cursing up a storm in your sleep, hypocrite this, swindler that, and a lot more besides... Tsk, I don't know where you managed to learn such creative Yanese.

steps.name: Young Chef
steps.text: The Ning Yin you mentioned, and whoever this Lin Qingyan is... Never seen them before, so I dunno if they were here.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: I need to go find them—

steps.name: Young Chef
steps.text: Whoa, whoa, where're you going?

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: The Forbidden City.

steps.name: Young Chef
steps.text: I just saw a whole bunch of guards patrolling around there. You think you can still get in?

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: I don't care. I have to go—

steps.name: Young Chef
steps.text: Who d'you think you're going to find, after having lost yourself like that?

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: You... What are you talking about?

steps.name: Young Chef
steps.text: Just speaking the truth here. You lost yourself, yeah?

steps.name: Young Chef
steps.text: You don't know where your self has gone, where it's wandered off to. You hear a few words from someone else and wouldn't you know it, you barely even know your own name, much less who you are.

steps.name: Young Chef
steps.text: Such absurdity...

steps.name: Young Chef
steps.text: A tangerine seed is blown from Jiangnan to Jiangbei, where it takes root and yields fine fruit. What let this seed grow so well wasn't Jiangnan or Jiangbei, but decades worth of rain and sun.

spans.text: A tangerine seed is blown from Jiangnan to Jiangbei, where it takes root and yields fine fruit. What let this seed grow so well wasn't Jiangnan
Jiangbei, but decades worth of rain and sun.

steps.name: Young Chef
steps.text: It's ultimately the same fruit. Jiangnan and Jiangbei might not be the same place, but an orange is an orange. Doesn't matter where you eat it.

steps.name: Young Chef
steps.text: All things begin, all things end. There is the outer truth, and the inner truth. Once you figure that out, then you can get back to asking your questions.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: You... Do you know something about all this? What do you know?! Tell me!

steps.name: Young Chef
steps.text: What do I know? I'm a chef, all I know is how to season my ingredients, how to boil stuff, stir-fry stuff, regular fry stuff—

steps.name: Young Chef
steps.text: Oh, right. Seeing you reminded me of something.

steps.name: Young Chef
steps.text: Weren't you trying to find authentic tangerine cakes?

steps.name: Young Chef
steps.text: I think I know how to make those.
